description: This Java source file defines a factory class for creating and manipulating policy-related objects within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for constructing labels, subjects, resources, policies, and their associated components, as well as JSON parsing and validation functionalities.

classes.name: PoliciesModelFactory
classes.description: A final utility class with static methods for creating and managing policy-related objects and parsing JSON representations into policy objects within the Eclipse Ditto framework.
